description: Use this when someone asks for the planetary hours or hora of a day and place, which planet rules the hour now, or when a planet’s hour comes ("planetary hours today in London", "what planetary hour is it", "when is the Venus hour today", "hora today"). Returns the twelve day hours and twelve night hours counted from sunrise, with clock times for that place, and the hour running now. Needs the town: ask if the person has not said it. Needs no birth details.

date.description: The date wanted, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for today at that place.

place.description: Town or city, with region or country if known, e.g. "Pune, India" or "Austin, Texas".

name: planetary_hours
title: Planetary hours for a day
